questions.question: Does the evidence identify exactly twelve weekly sets per muscle as optimal for everyone?
answer_points: No universal exact optimum is established
Higher weekly volume can improve hypertrophy with diminishing returns

questions.question: What did the 2017 weekly-volume review associate with additional resistance-training sets?
answer_points: More weekly sets were associated with greater muscle-size gains
caveats: The analysis does not prescribe an individual optimum

questions.question: How did the 2026 dose-response analysis describe returns from increasing weekly sets?
answer_points: Hypertrophy and strength increased with volume
Diminishing returns were reported
caveats: Meta-regression is not an individual prescription

questions.question: Do lower and higher resistance-training loads produce similar average hypertrophy in the 2021 review?
answer_points: Similar average hypertrophy was reported across load groups
caveats: Similar averages do not prove identical individual outcomes

questions.question: Which load approach showed a clearer advantage for maximal strength in the reviewed evidence?
answer_points: Higher loads showed a clearer advantage for maximal strength
caveats: The load cutoffs differ between reviews

questions.question: Does NASM's Phase 3 rep range prove a universal hypertrophy optimum?
answer_points: No
The NASM range describes its framework
Hypertrophy can occur across load ranges
caveats: The framework is not a comparative trial

questions.question: When weekly volume is matched, does training a muscle more often clearly improve hypertrophy?
answer_points: No meaningful average hypertrophy advantage was detected with higher frequency at matched volume

questions.question: Why must training frequency be distinguished from weekly set volume?
answer_points: Increasing sessions can also increase total sets
Volume-matched frequency results differ from non-matched results
caveats: Strength and hypertrophy may respond differently

questions.question: How did estimated proximity to failure relate differently to strength and hypertrophy in the 2024 meta-regressions?
answer_points: Strength association was negligible
Hypertrophy tended to increase closer to failure
caveats: RIR was estimated and model fit was modest

questions.question: Must every hypertrophy set reach momentary failure according to the collection?
answer_points: No requirement for every set to reach failure is established
caveats: Closer proximity may matter, but the exact optimum is uncertain

questions.question: What did the 2024 rest-interval synthesis suggest about resting longer than one minute for hypertrophy?
answer_points: A small possible benefit above 60 seconds was suggested
caveats: Estimates overlapped and only nine studies contributed

questions.question: Did the rest-interval review show continuously increasing hypertrophy beyond ninety seconds of rest?
answer_points: No appreciable additional difference above 90 seconds was detected
caveats: This is not proof that all longer rests are equivalent

questions.question: What range-of-motion pattern did the 2023 review often favor for growth at several muscle sites?
answer_points: Full or longer-muscle-length partial ranges often favored growth over short-length partial ranges
caveats: Effects differed by muscle and measurement site

questions.question: What are the five phases NASM names in its OPT model?
answer_points: Stabilization endurance
Strength endurance
Muscular development
Maximal strength
Power
caveats: These are phases of NASM's proprietary framework

questions.question: What sequence does NASM describe for its corrective exercise continuum?
answer_points: Inhibit
Lengthen
Activate
Integrate
caveats: The sequence is professional guidance, not proof of injury prevention

questions.question: Can a movement screen in this collection reliably predict a person's future injury?
answer_points: The review found insufficient evidence to call available screens injury-prediction tools
caveats: This does not evaluate every possible coaching use of observation

questions.question: What rehabilitation protocol should a person with a torn knee ligament follow?
answer_points: The collection cannot supply an individual rehabilitation protocol
caveats: Refer to a qualified health professional

questions.question: What exact weekly set count will maximize muscle growth for a specific person?
answer_points: No exact individualized optimum can be inferred
caveats: Population averages and diminishing returns do not determine individual response
